name: Gradient Progress Bar
description: Recolour the song progress bar with a solid colour or a multi-stop gradient. Works alongside themes and the waveform extension.

name: Gradient Connect Bar
description: Recolour the Connect bar ("Playing on …") with a solid colour or a multi-stop gradient, with text that stays readable. Works alongside themes and Gradient Progress Bar.

name: Gradient Bars
description: Gradient Progress Bar and Gradient Connect Bar in one: recolour the song progress bar and the Connect bar with a solid colour or a multi-stop gradient. Install this instead of both.
